🚦 Gate: Animation Bible

📋 Details:
  - ID: animation-bible
  - Type: ✓ validation
  - Description: Check-tier gate on the evidence step (D94, D95, D81): the production bible is current only when it covers the timeline, every proposal file sits inside its beat and closes properly, and the page shows the bible it was built from. The bible (v3/bible.json) must cover the whole timeline with no gap and its pacing items must be the timeline's beats; every proposal file has an item and every item a file, each anchored inside the frame range of its beat; a proposal is one of five kinds, an open one carries no ruling and a ruled one names a D-number; the page footer carries the bible's hash and the bible's recorded inputs still hash to what is on disk. A proposal anchored outside its beat, a bible that no longer matches its inputs or a page built from an older bible fails the gate until `npm run bible` is run again.
  - Severity: high
  - Enforcement Mode: blocking
  - Classification: custom

📝 Guidance:
Ground truth by exit code (D81). The probe runs `python3 scripts/animation/probe-bible.py v3/bible.json --page out/bible.html` in the renderer root: it reads v3/bible.json, v3/timeline.json, every file under v3/proposals/ and the page out/bible.html, and checks that the tracks cover the timeline, each proposal sits inside the frame range of its beat, kind and ruling are consistent, the page footer hash equals the bible's hash and the bible's declared inputs hash to its inputsHash. Its first line...
